summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held April 21, 2026. Shareholders authorized an increase in authorized share capital from $250M to $4.46B, creating 4.7B new Class A and 100M new Class B shares. They also granted the board a mandate to effect a share consolidation at a ratio between 2:1 and 200:1, at the board's discretion. Approximately 34% of votes were cast, with overwhelming approval. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premium, or strategic catalyst are present.
